text:
Michael: Quick follow-up from the postmortem this morning — we consolidated vendor/dependency mitigations into a single tracking list. Can everyone confirm ownership and timelines?
Alice: I can own the cloud-provider playbook updates (cross-region failover + quicker network fallback). Target: end of week (Fri). :white_check_mark:
Ben: I'll own model-registry auth fallback (short-term: cached-token fallback; long-term: multi-auth-provider support). ETA: 2 weeks.
Sophia: I'll take vendor escalation runbook and vendor SLA table (contacts + escalation matrix). Putting draft by Tue.
Carla: I'll do the postmortem action tracker sheet and add a column for recurring-pattern tags (e.g., auth-spike, kv-registry-throttle).
Michael: Thx. Two cross-cutting asks: 1) add a column for remediation owner + expected completion date, 2) tag items that are "recurring" so we can consider systemic fixes.
Ben: For model-registry, quick note — implement a lightweight local cache to reduce auth calls. Prototype: ```redis local_cache: ttl=5m``` Will post PR for review tomorrow.
Alice: Cloud fallback will include: DNS failover doc, script for re-routing traffic, and a smoke test that runs automatically on deployment. I'll add smoke-test spec to the repo.
Sophia: Vendor contacts — I have primary/secondary for both auth provider and model-storage. Will include Pager escalation steps and sample email templates.
Carla: Created tracker (link: https://go/redwood/incidents/remediation-tracker). Added columns: owner, eta, status, recurring_tag, notes. Please fill before EOD Wed.
Michael: Good. Two additional items: set recurring incident review cadence (monthly) and integrate the tracker into the weekly incident sync agenda. Also want an SLA for model-registry auth latency fallback — aim <200ms extra when using fallback.
Ben: Noted on SLA. Will bench prototype and post numbers by next Wed.
incident-bot: Reminder: weekly-incident-sync meeting scheduled Thu 14:00 UTC. Agenda item: remediation tracker review.
DevOps Bot: Deploy hook for smoke-test added to staging: `ci/smoke/cloud-failover-check`. Will enable once Alice's smoke-test spec lands.
Michael: Solid. Final ask: owners, please add an explicit rollback policy for each mitigation (who signs off, how to revert). We'll re-check in Thu sync. :thumbsup:
Alice: Will add rollback steps.
Ben: Adding rollback + test notes to PR.
Sophia: Escalation contacts + templates uploaded.
Carla: I'll run a quick query for "recurring_tag"=auth-spike across incidents and share findings before Thu.
Michael: Thanks team — assigning follow-ups in tracker now. If anything slips, ping me directly.
